description: This file defines a data class 'NextcloudConfig' that encapsulates the configuration details for connecting to a Nextcloud server, including credentials and headers. It also provides a method to create an instance from preferences asynchronously.

classes.name: NextcloudConfig
classes.description: A data class representing Nextcloud server configuration details such as address, username, and password, with methods to generate authentication headers and instantiate from preferences.

methods.name: fromPreferences
methods.description: A static method in the companion object that retrieves encrypted configuration strings from preferences and creates a Flow emitting NextcloudConfig instances if all values are valid.
